messages:
ben_sales: Quick sync: Large enterprise wants a pre-sales POC limited to EU regions only. Requests: explicit EU subprocessors list, BYO-HSM support, and confirmation that model artefacts never leave eu-central. Also wants proof for procurement.
sara_se: Do we know model family? That affects memory/KV cache needs. Short-chat load or long context?
ben_sales: They're evaluating chats + embeddings. Expected steady ~80 qps, spikes to 300qps during peak. Contexts mostly short (<128 tokens) but embeddings batch jobs for nightly jobs too.
kevin_security: Flags: BYO-HSM is supported but only in Dedicated and Private. For hosted, we can offer envelope keys but HSM-backed customer-managed keys require dedicated control plane. Need to prepare a short security attestation packet for procurement.
anna_ops: I can export subprocessors attestation PDF. Current EU subprocessors: AWS eu-central-1, GCP europe-west4, and a CDN partner in ireland. Will check DPIA presence.
redwood-bot: Ticket created: PRESALES-EU-882. Attach runbook: https://internal/runbooks/presales-eu.
julian_ae: Procurement asked for latency guarantees. If we do hosted with region-routing, we can't guarantee control-plane locality. Can we offer a hybrid: data plane in EU, control plane limited to EU endpoints via dedicated control-plane nodes?
sara_se: Hybrid is possible but it's effectively a dedicated control plane offering (ops + legal approval). For perf: to hit 300qps spikes with <250ms p50 for short chats, recommend autoscale to 3x small GPUs with warm KV caching. For embeddings nightly batch, we can schedule at off-peak to reduce cost.
kevin_security: I'll draft the attestation: SOC2 + subprocessors list + network flow diagram + DPIA summary. Also clarify telemetry: we can suppress non-essential telemetry and encrypt logs at rest; full-geo isolation of telemetry requires Private deployment.
anna_ops: Ops note: network egress path can be pinned to eu-central for data plane. We have a sample routing policy for customer ops teams. I'll paste it below.
anna_ops: routing config sample:

```
- tenant_id: tenant-xyz
  data_plane_region: eu-central-1
  control_plane_mode: dedicated-eu
  subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-central, gcp-europe-west4, cdn-ie]
  kms_mode: byo-hsm
  fallthrough_policy: deny
```

kevin_security: Important: "control_plane_mode: dedicated-eu" is not available as self-serve. Need legal + infra sign-off and a change request. I'll coordinate.
julian_ae: Pricing ask: customer asked for incremental price to add dedicated control plane + BYO-HSM. Can we give a ballpark?
sara_se: Roughly, add ~55-80% on top of hosted usage for dedicated control plane + BYO-HSM for SLA and reserved capacity (depends on model). Provide two scenarios: minimal (hosted + pin + caveat) and locked (dedicated control plane + BYO-HSM + reserved capacity).
ben_sales: Action list: 1) anna export subprocessors + DPIA (today EOD). 2) kevin to draft security attestation & telemetry note (tomorrow noon). 3) sara to produce perf/cost scenarios for bursty 300qps (tomorrow afternoon). 4) julian to prep procurement one-pager with sample routing config and pricing scenarios.
anna_ops: Will attach documents to PRESALES-EU-882 and share link.
kevin_security: Will include statement: "Hosted offering provides region pinning for data; full control-plane geographic guarantees require dedicated/private deployments and legal agreement."
julian_ae: I'll schedule a 30-min technical handoff with customer's infra next Wed. Will include ops, security, and se.
ben_sales: Great. Please post artifacts here when ready so I can pass to procurement. :handshake:
